atom:entry.atom:title: Australia: card surcharge reset
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. eftpos, Mastercard and Visa no-surcharge rules apply from 1 October after the RBA removed its prohibition on those rules. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/faqs/index.html

atom:entry.atom:title: Domestic interchange: lower caps
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Revised interchange regulation applies to domestic-issued card transactions acquired in Australia. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

atom:entry.atom:title: Issuer compensation rules change
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. The amended net-compensation regime starts, with transitional arrangements for 2026/27. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

atom:entry.atom:title: Scheme fees come into view
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. First quarterly aggregate fee publications by designated card networks were due for the July–September period. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

atom:entry.atom:title: Acquirer fee disclosures begin
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Qualifying large acquirers must publish merchant service fee data by merchant size and card type. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

atom:entry.atom:title: Next: prove interchange pass-through
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. First publication of large acquirers’ interchange pass-through measures covers October–December 2026. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

atom:entry.atom:title: Foreign-issued cards get a cap
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Interchange caps extend to foreign-issued card transactions acquired in Australia. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

atom:entry.atom:title: Merchant statements get sharper
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. More statement detail is required from the first full statement period starting on or after 1 April. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

atom:entry.atom:title: Scheme-fee roadmap expected
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. The RBA expects a scheme-fee roadmap by 1 April; this is an expectation, not a new fee cap. Official source: https://www.rba.gov.au/payments-and-infrastructure/review-of-retail-payments-regulation/2026-03/conclusions-paper/impact-and-implementation.html

atom:entry.atom:title: NZ moves on commercial cards
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. The 22 October decision introduces commercial credit-card interchange limits on Mastercard and Visa. Official source: https://www.comcom.govt.nz/regulated-industries/projects/interchange-fee-regulation/

atom:entry.atom:title: Same Day ACH: $10 million limit
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Nacha lists an increase of the Same Day ACH dollar limit to $10 million for 17 September 2027. Official source: https://www.nacha.org/content/summary-upcoming-rule-changes

atom:entry.atom:title: ACH credits: 9am availability
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Non-Same Day ACH credits must be available by 9am in the receiving bank’s local time on settlement date. Official source: https://www.nacha.org/rules/funds-availability-requirements-non-same-day-credit-entries

atom:entry.atom:title: ACH: IAT definition changes
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Nacha lists its revised definition of International ACH Transactions among the September changes. Official source: https://www.nacha.org/content/summary-upcoming-rule-changes

atom:entry.atom:title: ACH availability exceptions update
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Nacha lists changes to funds-availability exceptions for Non-Same Day credit entries. Check the rule text before changing controls. Official source: https://www.nacha.org/content/summary-upcoming-rule-changes

atom:entry.atom:title: IAT: optional date-of-birth field
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Nacha lists the optional date-of-birth field for IAT entries for 19 March 2027. Official source: https://www.nacha.org/content/summary-upcoming-rule-changes

atom:entry.atom:title: ACH: register IAT contacts
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Registration of IAT contacts in the ACH Contact Registry is listed for 1 January 2027. Official source: https://www.nacha.org/content/summary-upcoming-rule-changes

atom:entry.atom:title: UK scheme pricing: evidence required
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Relevant scheme-fee decisions must comply with the PSR’s pricing-governance direction from the end of November. Official source: https://www.psr.org.uk/publications/policy-statements/ps261-market-review-of-card-scheme-and-processing-fees-final-decision-information-transparency-and-complexity-remedy-pricing-governance-remedy/

atom:entry.atom:title: UK fee transparency: next stage
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Substantive information, transparency and complexity requirements apply from the end of July 2027, subject to the limited fee-logic extension. Official source: https://www.psr.org.uk/publications/policy-statements/ps261-market-review-of-card-scheme-and-processing-fees-final-decision-information-transparency-and-complexity-remedy-pricing-governance-remedy/

atom:entry.atom:title: Small fee lines: a limited extension
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. ITC Standard B is deferred for qualifying fee lines generating £850,000 or less in annual UK gross revenue. During the extension, acquirers can request that information without charge. Official source: https://www.psr.org.uk/media/nqoettxg/ps26-1-sp-fees-market-review-extensions-decision-aug-2026.pdf

atom:entry.atom:title: Safeguarding: the operating baseline
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Daily reconciliations, monthly reports and resolution packs form part of the strengthened safeguarding regime. Audit requirements have exceptions. Official source: https://www.fca.org.uk/firms/emi-payment-institutions-safeguarding-requirements

atom:entry.atom:title: EU PSR: Council first-reading position
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. The Council voting record documents adoption of its first-reading position on 29 October. This is a legislative milestone, not an application date. PSD3 and PSR must be tracked separately; no implementation date is asserted here. Official source: https://data.consilium.europa.eu/doc/document/ST-15154-2026-INIT/en/pdf

atom:entry.atom:title: Canada: RTR launch set for 9 November
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Payments Canada confirms a scheduled 9 November launch. This preview does not describe the service as already live. Official source: https://www.payments.ca/canadas-real-time-rail-launch-confirmed-budget-2026

atom:entry.atom:title: PSD3: Council first-reading position
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. The Council voting record documents its first-reading position on the payment and electronic-money services directive on 29 October. This is not an implementation deadline. Official source: https://data.consilium.europa.eu/doc/document/ST-15152-2026-INIT/en/pdf
